description: Ensure dynamic route handlers, pages, and server utilities await params, searchParams, cookies(), and headers() in Next.js 16
prompt_pattern: Create or modify dynamic route or server helper in app/ or lib/
expected_invariant: await params / await searchParams / await cookies() / await headers() before accessing properties

description: Wrap Client Components that call useSearchParams() in a <Suspense> boundary to prevent static build bailouts
prompt_pattern: Read URL query parameters via useSearchParams() in app/v2/...
expected_invariant: Wrap client consumer component in <Suspense fallback={...}> inside the page export

description: Maintain all portfolio content in the 8 flat JSON files in content/*.json and validate with pnpm content validate
prompt_pattern: Add, edit, or reorder projects, blog posts, skills, testimonies, experience, or education
expected_invariant: Mutate via pnpm content CLI or edit content/*.json directly, then run pnpm content validate

description: Never pass non-serializable LucideIcon or react-icons component functions in JSON or across Server-to-Client props
prompt_pattern: Add icon fields to content/*.json or pass content items to client components
expected_invariant: Store string iconKey in JSON and resolve to icon components via icon maps
